steps.body: Addition is a forward journey: start at the first number, jump the second number's worth to the right, land on the sum.
steps.narration: Addition is a forward journey: start at the first number, jump the second number's worth to the right, land on the sum.

commonLandings.feedback: That single hop banks one ten of the three — the journey continues to 77.

widget.missFeedback: Each hop is 10, going forward. From 47, 3 hops land on 77.
widget.successFeedback: 77 — the sum, reached one visible ten at a time.

predict.prompt: Adding on the line moves which way?
predict.reveal: Adding makes numbers bigger, and bigger always lives to the right — 3 + 5 or 30 + 50, both journeys end rightward.

cml.actionGoal: Manipulate the model and track how it represents g2l jump add.
invariants: Position on the line IS the number: equal jumps cover equal amounts, and a journey's landing depends only on start, jump size, and direction for g2l jump add.
misconceptions: Treating marks as decoration — unequal spacing, jumps of the wrong size, or reading a start mark as a landing.
cml.counterfactualPrompt: Which change — start, jump size, or direction — would move the landing, and which would leave it alone?

widget.prompt: 57 + 20 = ? (jumping forward by tens on the line)

commonErrors.feedback: Those jumps were ones — each forward jump here is a whole ten.
One jump too many; count the tens jumps the sum actually asks for.

widget.fallbackFeedback: Walk the line: find the start mark, take the jumps one at a time, and read the mark you land on.

explanationVariants: The drawing tells the sum's story.

widget.prompt: The first addend is the start. Which drawing shows 33 + 20?

options.label: Drawing A
options.feedback: Correct — the first addend is the starting mark and the second is the forward journey.

options.label: Drawing B
options.feedback: That drawing reaches the same total but tells the wrong story — 33 is where this sum begins.

options.label: Drawing C
options.feedback: Backward jumps subtract; a plus sign sends every jump to the right.

options.label: Drawing D
options.feedback: Dots alone show positions; a SUM needs the jump that joins them into a journey.
